definitions.gloss: averaging; leveling (out); smoothing out; standardization (toward an average)
definitions.explanation: The process of reducing variation across items, people, or values so that they become closer to a common average. Used both in technical/statistical contexts (smoothing data, leveling workload) and in social ones (standardization of wages, service quality, or abilities).

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{平均化|へいきんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{平均化|へいきんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to even out the workload.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ライン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作業量|さぎょうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{平均化|へいきんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: By leveling out the workload on the production line, efficiency improves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均化|へいきんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦されなく→する：00392_suru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If the leveling of evaluations progresses, there is a risk that truly outstanding employees will no longer be properly appraised.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧ (average) and the suffix -⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (-ization, turning into). A productive -⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ noun that refers to the act or process of making things averaged or leveled.

USAGE:
Used across technical, business, and social contexts:
- Statistics / engineering: smoothing of measurements, data, or loads.
- Business / operations: evening out workload, production volume, or service quality.
- Social / educational: leveling of abilities, grades, or outcomes — sometimes with a negative connotation of suppressing individuality or excellence.

Can be used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {平均化|へいきんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ 'to average out, to level'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{負荷|ふか}→負荷：14231_fuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{平均化|へいきんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to level out the load (computing, engineering)
- {作業量|さぎょうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{平均化|へいきんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to even out the workload
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{平均化|へいきんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to average / smooth data
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均化|へいきんか}: the leveling of abilities
- {平均化|へいきんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: leveling progresses / becomes more pronounced

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{均一化|きんいつか}→均一化：08084_kinitsuka⟧: uniformization — making things uniform or identical; stronger than {平均化|へいきんか}, which only brings values closer to an average
- {平滑化|へいかつか}: smoothing — a technical term in data processing, particularly in signal processing or image processing
- ⟦{標準化|ひょうじゅんか}→標準化：20534_hyoujunka⟧: standardization — making things conform to a standard, not necessarily an average
- {一律化|いちりつか}: uniform application (across cases) — emphasizes treating everyone the same
